title: Great tour, great guide!
text: We loved our guide and we got to see a lot of really neat places in Barcelona that aren’t the huge tourist attractions every one knows about. Plus, he gave us a lot of great history about the city.
author: Brian_S

title: Bike tour
text: Very accommodating to what we wanted to see. Very knowledgable. 4 hours was too long for my group. Did 2.5.
author: Rachel_P

title: E-bike Tour Fun!
text: Jean Pierre gave a thoroughly enjoyable tour of the city, highlighting the most important locations and provided us with his historical knowledge. He safely toured throughout the city and was a joy!
author: Cathie_W

title: Outstanding EBike Tour
text: Jean-Pierre was an incredible and knowledgeable guide. He took us on an extensive tour and we learned so much about the history and architecture of Barcelona. He is very accommodating and was very cognizant of all riders safety navigating through the city.
author: Andrew_C

title: Private e-bike tour of Barcelona
text: What a perfect day to tour Barcelona on a bicycle! Jean Pierre was an absolute pleasure. His tour was very informative and he knows the streets and the destinations so well. If you’re comfortable on a bike and want to cover some ground, this is the way to go. Four hours went by way too fast!!
author: Dimitry_F

title: Great way to see Barcelona
text: This private tour was perfect.  Jean Pierre discussed options for the ride and we saw so many things in Barcelona, the coast, the Olympic site, parks, historic sites.  Jean Pierre was able to keep us on bike paths most of the time and did not have to fight the busy streets.  We were able to proceed at our pace and it was a wonderful way to see the city.
author: Julie_L

title: Excellent Private Cycle tour in Barcelona
text: An excellent over 4 hours trip.  Jean Pierre was excellent - he took us to many landmarks and was extremely knowledgeable about the history of Barcelona.  With electric bikes it was so easy
author: Andrew_W

title: Do this one!
text:
Jean-Pierre was very thoughtful and thorough. He will tailor the tour to your liking- and can be very detailed- or brief if you prefer.  

Perfect for a small group-  the streets can get crowded- so be prepared to dodge a few pedestrians- but it was safe and fun and I would do this again. 

Great way to learn and get the layout of a new city if you’ve never been.
author: Sascha_C

title: Jean-Pierre is the best guide
text: The best way to see all of Barcelona; do it early in your visit! Electric bikes make it easy and fun. Jean-Pierre was very friendly, knowledgeable and patient.
author: Robert_W

title: Barcelona city tour
text: Jean Pierre was an excellent guide!  What an awesome way to experience Barcelona. …….,,,,,,,,,……………..
author: Chris_G
